items.title: The BSO Meets AI, and Explores the Vitality of Classical Music Today | The Harvard Crimson
items.summary:
At the center of Machover’s composition philosophy is his belief that classical music finds a natural extension and innovation in technology. He revealed in an interview with GBH music that the music he hears in his head is often beyond the scope of traditional instruments. Thus, alongside the MIT Media Lab, Machover has developed an audio AI that takes in the playing of the orchestra as input and produces live synthetic sounds that — as Machover puts it — “enhances” the orchestra. [...] From Oct. 22 to 24, the Boston Symphony Orchestra and conductor Kent Nagano performed “already and not yet: A world premiere by Tod Machover.” The headliner was a modern classical work: an onstage musical dialogue between the BSO and a live AI system. Beyond the philosophical implications of the concept, the performance struck at a key nerve of classical music culture — a delicate balancing of tradition and relevance. [...] The piece was divided into three movements. The first movement, “SMASH UP,” was, in Machover’s words, a “clash/crisis” without audible enhancement from the AI.

The second, “WAKE UP,” was an “awakening”: the AI slowly produced sound in response to various solo lines in the orchestra. Then the last movement, “STAND UP,” was a “depiction of democracy,” as the musicians and AI listened to one another and negotiated the final musical product.

items.title: I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop.
items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của hàm số $f(x) = x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Trong đó $C$ là hằng số thực bất kỳ. 

*(Giải thích: Theo quy tắc tính nguyên hàm của lũy thừa $\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$ với $n \neq -1$, ta thay $n = 2$ vào sẽ được $\frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$.)*

items.title: The BSO Meets AI, and Explores the Vitality of Classical Music Today | The Harvard Crimson
items.summary:
At the center of Machover’s composition philosophy is his belief that classical music finds a natural extension and innovation in technology. He revealed in an interview with GBH music that the music he hears in his head is often beyond the scope of traditional instruments. Thus, alongside the MIT Media Lab, Machover has developed an audio AI that takes in the playing of the orchestra as input and produces live synthetic sounds that — as Machover puts it — “enhances” the orchestra. [...] From Oct. 22 to 24, the Boston Symphony Orchestra and conductor Kent Nagano performed “already and not yet: A world premiere by Tod Machover.” The headliner was a modern classical work: an onstage musical dialogue between the BSO and a live AI system. Beyond the philosophical implications of the concept, the performance struck at a key nerve of classical music culture — a delicate balancing of tradition and relevance. [...] The piece was divided into three movements. The first movement, “SMASH UP,” was, in Machover’s words, a “clash/crisis” without audible enhancement from the AI.

The second, “WAKE UP,” was an “awakening”: the AI slowly produced sound in response to various solo lines in the orchestra. Then the last movement, “STAND UP,” was a “depiction of democracy,” as the musicians and AI listened to one another and negotiated the final musical product.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là đoạn mã Python tính số Fibonacci bằng phương pháp đệ quy (recursion):

```python
def fibonacci(n):
    """Tính số Fibonacci thứ n sử dụng đệ quy.

    Lưu ý: Phương pháp này có độ phức tạp thời gian là O(2^n)
    và không hiệu quả với các giá trị n lớn.
    """
    # Điều kiện cơ sở (base cases)
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    # Bước đệ quy
    else:
        return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)


# Ví dụ sử dụng:
# In ra 10 số Fibonacci đầu tiên
for i in range(10):
    print(f"F({i}) = {fibonacci(i)}")
```

Nếu bạn cần tối ưu hóa hiệu suất cho các giá trị lớn hơn (tránh lặp lại các phép tính), bạn có thể sử dụng thêm `@functools.lru_cache` hoặc phương pháp quy hoạch động (dynamic programming).

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

## OpenAI được định giá 1.250 tỷ USD

# OpenAI được định giá 1.250 tỷ USD

Định giá của công ty mẹ ChatGPT không cao như kỳ vọng sau vòng huy động vốn mới nhất, thu về 11 tỷ USD. [...] Ngày 6/11, Reuters trích nguồn tin thn cận cho biết OpenAI vừa hoàn thành vòng huy động vốn mới, thu về 11 tỷ USD. Lần này, công ty mẹ ChatGPT được định giá 1.250 tỷ USD. Gã khổng lồ viễn thông Nhật Bản SoftBank và quỹ đầu tư công nghệ MGX (UAE) đều tham gia rót vốn.

Tuy nhiên, cả số tiền và mức định giá vòng này đều thấp hơn dự định ban đầu, hai nhà đầu tư cho biết. Trước đó, OpenAI đặt mục tiêu huy động tối đa 30 tỷ USD với mức định giá 1.500 tỷ USD. [...] Hồi tháng 6, OpenAI đã bí mật nộp hồ sơ phát hành cổ phiếu lần đầu ra công chúng (IPO). Tuy nhiên, đến tháng 9, CEO Sam Altman cho biết sẽ không làm IPO năm nay, do các lo ngại về an toàn với trí tuệ nhn tạo (AI). "Tôi thực sự cho rằng, với tất cả những gì đang diễn ra, liên quan đến vấn đề an toàn, thời điểm hiện tại không thích hợp để IPO và chúng tôi cũng không chịu áp lực phải làm điều đó", Altman cho biết.

items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
In 2023, Leopold Aschenbrenner, then an OpenAI researcher, wrote an internal memo titled “OpenAI is China’s leading AI lab” about his concerns that China could infiltrate OpenAI and study its technology, three people familiar with the matter said.

Aschenbrenner shared that memo with some board members later that year after an outsider hacked into OpenAI and took details about its GPT-4 model. OpenAI said the hacker accessed only Slack channels available to the whole company.
